subject: Next steps: procurement & security gating for NovaMetrics trial
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Zhao <emma.zhao@novametrics.ai>, Jake Patel <j.patel@novametrics.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-05T16:12:00Z
Subject: Next steps: procurement & security gating for NovaMetrics trial

Hi Emma / Jake — thanks again for carving out time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Call recap (30 min)
- Goal: 6-week pilot (250k token/month), evaluate latency & cost for inference at scale.
- Commercial preference: procurement team evaluating PO (paperflow) vs card vs AWS Marketplace.
- Security gating: NovaMetrics requires DPA + SOC 2 evidence and completion of a security questionnaire before PO approval.

Procurement options (short):
- Card: fastest to spin up (self-serve) but procurement prefers PO for enterprise invoicing.
- PO / paper process: we can accept PO with standard terms (Net 30) and provide invoice + backup docs; will need a signed DPA before production access.
- Marketplace: available as an option if you want billing via AWS Marketplace (faster for some procurement teams) — pricing/discounts differ and entitlements vary.

Security/compliance notes:
- Attaching a 1-page SOC 2 summary and our DPA template (attachment: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf).
- We can complete your security questionnaire; common asks we expect: encryption at rest, key management, log retention, access control, data retention/erasure.

Immediate next steps (mutual action plan):
1) Emma: confirm preferred procurement path (PO vs card vs marketplace) and procurement lead contact.
2) NovaMetrics: share security questionnaire (or point me to the link) — we can return a first-pass within 48 hours.
3) Redwood: Marissa will draft a PO-friendly quote and provide our PO template + signed DPA route; Karthik will pull SOC 2 artifacts to attach.
4) If PO selected: we may schedule a 15-min call between procurement/legal to align on terminology.

Proposed timeline:
- Confirm procurement path by Tue 6/8
- First-pass questionnaire responses by Wed 6/9
- DPA draft returned by Fri 6/11

If that looks good I’ll get Marissa to send a formal quote and the PO template today. Would Tuesday 6/9 for a short handover call work for procurement/legal on your side?

Thanks — Ser

--
Sergio Alvarez
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
From: Emma Zhao <emma.zhao@novametrics.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jake Patel <j.patel@novametrics.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-06T09:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Next steps: procurement & security gating for NovaMetrics trial

Hi Sergio — thanks for the clear recap. A few quick answers: 
- Procurement preference: PO if we can get Net 30 terms and a straightforward DPA. Marketplace might be a fallback but procurement will prefer PO.
- I uploaded our security questionnaire here: https://docs.novametrics.ai/sec-questionnaire-2027 (you should have access). Key asks we flagged internally: encryption at rest (who manages keys / KMS), data residency options, retention & deletion workflow, and logging/audit proofs.
- Procurement lead is Jake Patel (copied). He’ll own the PO and contract flow.

We’ll need the SOC 2 summary and any evidence you can share to speed review. If you can send a PO template and a draft DPA that would help procurement move quickly.

Also: pricing question — will we see the same per-token rates if we go via marketplace vs PO? Happy to discuss offline.

Emma
VP Product, NovaMetrics
emma.zhao@novametrics.ai
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Zhao <emma.zhao@novametrics.ai>, Jake Patel <j.patel@novametrics.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-06T13:00:00Z
Subject: Re: Next steps: procurement & security gating for NovaMetrics trial

Emma — perfect, thanks for confirming and for the questionnaire link. Short answers inline and next moves: 

- PO terms: we can accept PO with Net 30; Marissa will attach our PO template and a formal quote by EOD today.
- Marketplace vs PO pricing: base price is comparable but marketplace transactions may have platform fees/price parity nuance. Marissa will call out any delta in the quote.
- SOC 2 & DPA: Karthik will pull our SOC 2 summary + control matrix; I’m attaching the one-page summary now. We’ll draft a DPA and return it for your legal review.
- Questionnaire: Redwood can complete your questionnaire. We’ll aim for a first-pass return within 48 hours (target: 6/8). For the specific items you flagged (KMS, data residency, retention, logs) — Karthik will draft the answers.

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (short), PO_template_redwood.docx (will be in Marissa's follow-up).

Next: Marissa — can you send the formal quote + PO template? Karthik — can you pull the SOC 2 extract and start FAQ answers for the questionnaire (encryption/KMS, retention windows, audit logs, access controls)?

Thanks — Sergio

--
Sergio Alvarez
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-07T11:03:00Z
Subject: INTERNAL: Re: Next steps: procurement & security gating for NovaMetrics trial

Internal quick plan / action items (for Marissa & Karthik) — copying timeline so we can close this week: 

Context: NovaMetrics (deal NM-2027-0421) is likely to go PO + DPA. Procurement lead Jake Patel; Product lead Emma Zhao. They expect SOC 2 evidence + completed questionnaire to approve PO.

Action items: 
1) Marissa (owner for commercial) — prepare a PO-friendly quote (line items: trial credit for 6 weeks 250k tokens/month; estimated overage rates) and attach Redwood PO template. Include Net 30 terms and call out marketplace price parity note. Deliverable: quote + PO_template_redwood.docx by EOD 6/7.
2) Karthik (owner for security artifacts) — pull SOC 2 Type II summary, control mapping for data-in-transit/at-rest, KMS details, and a redacted report excerpt. Draft initial answers to the questionnaire items Emma flagged (KMS, data residency, retention, audit logs). Deliverable: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf + nova-questionnaire-answers-draft.docx by 6/8 morning.
3) Sergio — I’ll return the first-pass questionnaire to Emma (once Karthik’s draft is in), and then loop legal for a DPA draft (aim to send to NovaMetrics legal by 6/9).

Dependencies / notes:
- If they insist on Marketplace for procurement, marissa should include the Marketplace SKU and note potential platform fee differences.
- If PO, legal will need to review DPA — allow 2 business days for Redwood legal.

Links: HubSpot deal -> https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/13579 (NM-2027-0421)
Attachments to include when replying: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf, nova-questionnaire-answers-draft.docx (draft).

Please ack and I’ll follow up with Emma once we have the artifacts.

- Ser

--
Sergio Alvarez
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
(end of thread)
